intro: Czechia is one of the most industrial economies in Europe, building cars, machinery and glass, and brewing world-famous beer.

chapters.title: Cars and glass
text: Škoda, now part of Volkswagen, is one of Europe's best-selling car brands, and Czechia makes more cars per person than almost any other country. Bohemian crystal glass has been prized for centuries.

chapters.title: Beer and tech
text: In 1842 brewers in Plzeň created the first pale lager, Pilsner, a style now brewed around the world. Czech software companies such as Avast and game studios have also become successful.

keyTerms.meaning: A type of beer brewed at cool temperatures.
